name: finish-product
job: Finish and deburr an integrated product to its declared target with re-captured render, play, regression, and delivery evidence.

inScope: Binding the exact integrated subject and declared finish target
Resolving the one core concept deeply with no material placeholders
Running render/play matrix, regression, and budget checks
Recapturing and verifying evidence after corrections
outOfScope: Inventing product strategy, prices, policy, or launch approval

inputs: Integrated product or release candidate and its promise
Declared finish target and approved direction
outputs: Product Finish Pass: target, coverage, and implemented corrections
Remaining blockers and truthful delivery state

tools: render/play matrix tooling for the product surface
data: current build, content, config, and platform inventory

failureSemantics: Functional, compilable, or clickable is not finished; the declared target is never silently lowered, and a report-only response is incomplete in finish mode.

outcome.observable: The product reaches its declared finish target with re-captured render or playthrough evidence, regression and budget checks, and a blocker list that names remaining delivery state truthfully.
